parameters.content:
## Meta Pixel Flatline Detector

Catches Meta pixels that have silently stopped firing, before you lose days of conversion tracking. Alerts with an AI diagnosis of the likely cause.

### How it works
- Lists every pixel on your ad account and reads when each last fired, from the Meta Marketing API.
- Flags any pixel that has not received an event for longer than your flatline threshold, or has never fired.
- Claude explains the most likely cause (a site deploy removed the tag, consent blocking, a GTM misfire, low traffic) and the first thing to check.

### Setup
1. Add to your environment: META_ACCESS_TOKEN, META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID, META_API_VERSION, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
2. Run with the manual trigger, or attach a Schedule trigger to check every few hours.

### Customization
In the Config node, tune FLATLINE_HOURS and WARN_HOURS to your traffic volume. Swap the report node for a Slack or email node to get paged the moment a pixel goes dark.

Built by **nocode.expert** - done-for-you automation & tracking. https://nocode.expert

## 1. Read pixels
List every pixel and when it last fired.

## 2. Detect flatlines
Flag pixels quiet past the threshold, then Claude diagnoses why.

## 3. Report
Print the flatline report (swap for Slack/email).
